originalTitle: Kagi added a setting for removing paywalled links from search results
content:
August 21st, 2026 - A new Stocks widget and a better everyday Assistant experience #

We've revamped our Stocks widget. It should appear more often when you need it. It can now display information about exchange-traded funds in addition to stocks. Most importantly, it now features a price chart, with animations between time windows that instantly contexturalize how big the price fluctuations you're seeing are compared to the wider story:

As well, we've added a setting for removing paywalled links from search results automatically.

Richer messages User messages now render links, Markdown, and LaTex. #6674 @oxlvlnle , #3283 @EvacuatedTerminal

More powerful search Search across all your threads, sort by recency or alphabetically, and start with / to filter by folder.

More control with calmer settings Now you can choose whether temporary threads stick around for 24h, 7 or 30 days. All within a calmer, easier-to-scan settings experience.
chineseTitle: Kagi 添加了从搜索结果中删除付费链接的设置
chineseContent:
2026 年 8 月 21 日 - 新的股票小部件和更好的日常助理体验 #

我们改进了股票小部件。当您需要时，它应该更频繁地出现。除了股票之外，它现在还可以显示有关交易所交易基金的信息。最重要的是，它现在具有价格图表，时间窗口之间有动画，可以立即将您看到的价格波动与更广泛的故事相比有多大：

此外，我们还添加了自动从搜索结果中删除付费链接的设置。

更丰富的消息 用户消息现在呈现链接、Markdown 和 LaTex。 #6674 @oxlvlnle , #3283 @EvacuatedTerminal

更强大的搜索 搜索所有线程，按新近度或字母顺序排序，并以 / 开头按文件夹过滤。

通过更平静的设置进行更多控制现在，您可以选择临时线程是否保留 24 小时、7 天或 30 天。一切都在更平静、更易于扫描的设置体验中。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
